title:
Transform for the `FetchResult<ReliabilityAsset>` retrieved for the `Reliability.AllAssetsCardList` component.

This transform is responsible for adding translated text next to certain fields of each ReliabilityAsset to make
them more presentable in the UI.

Additionally, the transform also retrieves an asset importance numerical indicator shown in the card list
for each asset's importance level.
name: ReliabilityAssetCardListFetchResultTransform
